neighbours.label: unclear weak pole; best guess a conclusive connective ('Thus', 'Hence', 'Por lo tanto') opening a sentence that draws a consequence
fire: The river flooded the lower fields in April. Thus, the harvest came three weeks late.
The contract was never signed by both parties. Hence, it has no legal force.
The data showed no difference between the groups. Thus, the drug had no effect.
The roads were icy all morning. Hence, the school opened two hours late.
La empresa perdió a su mayor cliente. Por lo tanto, cerró dos oficinas.
Our power bill doubled over the winter. Therefore, we bought better insulation.
The glue had not dried overnight. Thus, the shelf fell when we loaded it.
The witness was abroad at the time. Hence, her statement was ruled out.
quiet: The river flooded the lower fields in April. Later, the harvest came three weeks late.
The contract was never signed by both parties. Also, it was printed on old paper.
The data showed no difference between the groups. Meanwhile, the second trial began.
The roads were icy all morning. Then, the sun came out around noon.
La empresa perdió a su mayor cliente. Además, cambió de director.
Our power bill doubled over the winter. Also, the boiler made strange noises.
The glue had not dried overnight. Later, we painted the other shelf.
The witness was abroad at the time. Afterwards, she moved to Lisbon.
